Comprobar que lo ingerido se recupera: Check that what is ingested can be retrieved
Comprobar que se recupera lo ingerido: Check that what was ingested is retrievable
Propuestas por brain y hora que se compr: Proposals per brain and hour that are checked; the rest stay unchecked and say so.
Tras ingerir una propuesta, se hace al r: After a proposal is ingested, the recall is asked one control question per new fact (up to 5), and the proposal is flagged if one does not come back among the first. Each question is one embedding.
